incentives.name: Data center sales tax exemption
incentives.law: Idaho Code 63-3622VV (enacted 2020); property tax abatement Idaho Code 63-4502
incentives.what: Sales tax exemption for qualifying data centers on construction materials and internal server equipment (enacted 2020), plus property tax abatement for large capital investments (63-4502). HB 897 (2026) would have narrowed it to servers, added energy and water criteria and a 20-year limit, but did not become law.

dockets.what: Energy services agreement (special contract) for Brisbie LLC's new data center near Kuna (Meta), with 100% renewable support on an annual basis. Final Order 35777.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 911 (2026) - new large loads
laws_and_bills.what: Adds law providing for new large electrical loads (50 MW or more per ICL); signed April 10, 2026; Session Law ch. 335; effective July 1, 2026.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 895 (2026) - data center cooling water
laws_and_bills.what: Limits consumptive use of water for cooling certain data centers; signed April 2, 2026; Session Law ch. 291; effective July 1, 2026.

laws_and_bills.name: HB 897 (2026) - data center tax exemptions
laws_and_bills.what: Would have narrowed the data center equipment sales tax exemption and a property tax exemption for large capital investments. Passed House 68-0 and Senate as amended 34-0-1; House never concurred, so it died at session end.

local_rules.what: After denying Lex Developments' data center, the City Council kept a one-year reapply bar so staff can update the city code for data centers.
